description: The file is a FastAPI backend module for a career pathway navigator. It defines API endpoints for health checking, role listing and detail retrieval, progress tracking, graph data generation, recommendations, and assessments. It also includes startup initialization logic, logging, and utility functions.

methods.name: None on_startup()
methods.description: Initializes the database, creates tables, and seeds minimal data if roles are absent.

methods.name: List[RoleOut] list_roles(db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: API endpoint that returns a list of all roles.

methods.name: RoleDetailOut get_role_detail(role_name: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: API endpoint that returns detailed information about a specific role, including skills and recommendations.

methods.name: List[ProgressOut] get_role_progress(role_name: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: API endpoint that returns progress entries for a specific role.

methods.name: ProgressOut set_progress( role_name: str, skill_name: str = Query(..., min_length=2, max_length=200, description="Skill name"), status: str = Query(..., pattern="^(not_started|working_on|complete)$", description="Progress status"), current_level: int = Query(..., ge=0, le=5, description="Current skill level"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: API endpoint to create or update progress for a skill within a role.

methods.name: GraphOut get_graph( fromRole: int = Query(..., ge=1, description="Current role ID"), toRole: int = Query(..., ge=1, description="Target role ID"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: API endpoint that generates a D3-compatible graph of roles and skills connections.

methods.name: List[RecommendationOut] get_recommendations( roleId: int = Query(..., ge=1, description="Role ID"), skillId: int = Query(..., ge=1, description="Skill ID"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: API endpoint providing recommendations for a specific role and skill.

methods.name: AssessmentOut assess_roles(payload: AssessmentIn, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: API endpoint to assess strengths and gaps between current and target roles.

methods.name: Optional[Role] _get_role_by_id(repo: RoleRepository, role_id: int)
methods.description: Helper function to retrieve role by ID utilizing the cached list from RoleRepository.

methods.name: str _sanitize(value: str)
methods.description: Utility to sanitize string inputs by trimming and removing control characters.
